text:
alex_w: saw a weird latency tail on the A100 pool during the continuous-batching stress run. p99 spikes ~120ms but GPU kernels only account for ~6ms. nsys timeline shows host CPU spikes and gaps between kernels. anyone seen host launch serialization before?

maya_r: can you attach an nsys capture? which flags did you use? link would help.

alex_w: uploaded a short trace -> perfetto://redwood/local/trace/abcd1234 (private). ran with:
```
nsys profile -o trace --trace=nvtx,cuda,osrt -t 10 --sample=cpu --sample_interval=1000 --capture-range=nvtx
```

jordan_p: skimmed the NVTX regions. kernel invocations look back-to-back on the GPU, but there's a 20-40ms host-side gap where CPU threads are doing small memcpy+mutex work. Kernel launch latency is small but hosts are serialized by a mutex in batch_scheduler.cpp:allocate_slot()

ciara-bot: KV cache sweeper also kicked in at ~T+4s in the trace and did a few MB copy loops. That coincides with a cluster of queue-time spikes.

maya_r: interesting — two hypotheses: 1) host-side scheduling + allocator mutex; 2) kvcache eviction IO stalls. quick repro: increase batching window from 6ms->14ms, or toggle kvcache sweep to deferred mode.

alex_w: ran the experiment locally. numbers before/after (micro-bench, mixed-length):
- baseline (6ms window): p50 22ms, p95 65ms, p99 118ms
- wider window (14ms): p50 25ms, p95 52ms, p99 74ms
So widening reduced tail but raised median slightly (expected).

jordan_p: confirms what I'd expect: wider window increases pooling opportunities so amortizes allocator overhead. But for SLOs we might want a smarter scheduling tweak: async prealloc + optimistic slot assign to eliminate the mutex path for cold slots.

alex_w: here's a short nsys timeline snippet (simplified):
```
0.000s: host memcpy (3ms)
0.003s: lm_forward kernel (2ms)
0.005s: host mutex lock/alloc (28ms)
0.033s: lm_forward kernel (2ms)
```
Kernel names alternate between flash_attn_fwd and lm_fwd_small — we also saw fallback to non-fused kernels in ~8% of invocations when seq_len > 1024 which increases host prep.

maya_r: could be kernel selection path hitting a memcopy/transform step for nonfused variant. try forcing the fused kernel via ENV_FORCE_KERNEL=flashfwd to validate.

alex_w: forced kernel, re-ran single-run with kvcache sweep disabled. tail collapsed: p99 from 118ms->68ms. So both factors matter.

sre-bot: [deploy-check] Canary job queued: ded-runtime/host-alloc-proto.eta=2h

jordan_p: next action: 1) land async prealloc patch (small PR), 2) add deferred kvcache-sweep flag default-off for hotpath, 3) telemetry: capture host mutex wait histograms in traces.

alex_w: assigning tasks -> jordan (async prealloc), maya (kvcache flag + canary), alex (telemetry + perf baseline). I'll open PRs and tag ops.

maya_r: I'll coordinate the canary and post results here. thanks.

alex_w: thanks all, will follow up with perfetto link and PRs once ready.
